title: The operator watches the kb's health and landings: an eval alert, a local Prometheus scrape and landing-step timings
goal: kbotel.py keeps a tool_result's duration_ms, success and tool_result_size_bytes that Claude Code sends as strings; kbmon raises an eval alert while the newest recorded lookup eval at a landing failed; otel/ holds a Prometheus scrape config and alert rules whose every metric the adapter's /metrics serves, and kb/_self/monitoring.md says how to run the adapter with a local Prometheus; backlog.py landings prints each landing step's count, failures, median and 95th percentile duration from the ops rows
